metrics.profile_summary: Senior digital marketing professional with over 9 years of experience specializing in paid media, SEO, and lead generation. Proven track record in scaling campaigns and managing high-value client portfolios across diverse industries.

experience.description: Optimized Google and Meta Ads, implemented GTM and GA4 conversion tracking, and enhanced landing page funnels to improve CPL and conversion rates.
Planned marketing events and university seminars while maintaining lead pipelines and email marketing campaigns.
Managed annual ad budgets exceeding $25,000 and successfully reduced offline marketing expenditures by $12,000.
Drove a 22% increase in company revenue through the implementation of strategic digital lead generation campaigns.
Managed multi-channel campaigns across email, social, and web, achieving a 6% year-over-year KPI improvement.
Launched and scaled a full-service consultancy focusing on PPC, SEO, and study abroad services.

strengths: Expert-level proficiency in Meta Ads and Google Ads
Strong technical tracking skills (GA4, GTM) for UTM and reporting
Proficient in Canva and MS Office
weaknesses: No explicit mention of TikTok management
Bachelor's degree not explicitly listed in CV text
evaluation.summary: The candidate is overqualified for a Specialist role but possesses every required technical skill, including the 'nice-to-haves'. His deep expertise in Meta Ads and analytics ensures he can handle campaign setup and reporting with ease.
